messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

### Short answer
To compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense, the evidence must directly connect the same Aerospace / Defense use case, our exact signal generator / signal analyzer configuration, the competitor’s exact configuration, and the same test conditions; the provided passages only separately mention “Aerospace & Defense Test” and “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer,” not a supported competitor comparison [97][99].
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Supported basis |
|---|---|---|
| Our exact product models, option codes, document version, and dated specifications must be cited from official product documents. | R&S SMW200A claims should be tied to its configuration guide and specifications, and R&S FSW claims should be tied to its specifications document version and date. | SMW200A evidence is based on `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator – Configuration guide` Version 06.00 May 2024 and `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` Version 31.00 May 2026 [2]. FSW evidence is based on `FSW_specs_en_5215-6749-22_v1701`, Version 17.01, September 2025 [67]. |
| The competitor’s official datasheet, model/SKU, option codes, version, release status, and test conditions must be collected before making claims. | Existing competitor material is not enough where it lacks official datasheets, versions, order numbers, option codes, or test conditions. | The Keysight battle card lacks official UXM datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, and test conditions [10]. The Anritsu page says product frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option code, software tools, and support model need verification with Anritsu official datasheets, release notes, or support terms [15]. |
| The Aerospace / Defense application must be tied to the actual SG/SA use case, not just co-mentioned. | The available raw evidence separately names Aerospace & Defense Test and Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer, but it does not state a competitor comparison. | The raw passages show “Aerospace & Defense Test” in a presentation title context [97]. The raw passages separately list “Signal Generator” and “Signal Analyzer” [99]. |
| If the use case is satellite payload testing, use the application evidence that explicitly links R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A to complete payload testing. | This is a supported SG/SA application link, but it is not a competitor comparison by itself. | R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are recommended for complete payload testing [34]. The same source says they cover group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality for satellite payload and component testing [53]. |
| Comparable specifications must include the exact measurement conditions and whether the data is warranted, typical, nominal, or measured. | Non-warranted or conditionless numbers should not be used as binding comparison claims. | SMW200A product data applies after 3 hours storage at ambient temperature, 30 minutes warm-up, specified environmental conditions, recommended calibration interval, and applicable internal adjustments [61]. SMW200A specifications with and without limits are warranted, while `n. trc.`, `typ.`, `nom.`, and `meas.` are not guaranteed [61]. FSW product data has its own 3-hour storage, 30-minute warm-up, environmental, calibration, and adjustment conditions [66]. |
| Frequency range, bandwidth, and option requirements must be compared only where both sides have official evidence. | Our side has supported SG/SA specifications, but competitor-side equivalent evidence is not provided in the passages. | SMW200A RF path A can cover up to `100 kHz to 67 GHz`, RF path B can cover up to `100 kHz to 44 GHz`, and wideband baseband RF modulation bandwidth can reach `2 GHz` under stated conditions [63]. FSW models cover up to 85 GHz, and FSW85 with R&S FSW-B90G can extend to 90 GHz [68]. FSW analysis bandwidth options range up to 8.312 GHz with option-specific applicability and restrictions [6]. |
| Claims such as “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or competitor weaknesses require formal external evidence. | Existing battle-card wording is sales positioning and cannot be treated as verified technical fact. | The Keysight battle card contains sales language such as only, first, leadership, lower TCO, and fewer boxes, and says formal evidence is needed before using those claims in technical comparisons or customer documents [25]. The R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu page says “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “widest frequency range,” and “lower TCO” are sales language and should not be treated as verifiable technical specifications [30]. |
| Customer adoption, market share, procurement, or partnership claims require separate dated evidence. | A market mapping or equipment recommendation does not prove adoption, customer fit, or commercial relationship. | The Taiwan satellite mapping page says R&S Solution mappings do not indicate supply, purchase, mass production, certification, contract, shipment, revenue contribution, or commercial relationship with Rohde & Schwarz [57]. The Starlink User Terminal flow says equipment recommendations must not be used to infer R&S, Keysight, or Terma adoption or commercial relationships [42]. |
| Standards-based Aerospace / Defense claims require the actual standard version, test category, limits, setup, and pass/fail criteria. | The available DO-160 and military drone EMC materials are only solution or presentation-level summaries, not formal standards. | The DO-160 page says it is not a formal RTCA DO-160 standard summary and must not be used to infer complete categories, limits, waveforms, test setup, or pass/fail criteria [21]. The military UAV EMC page says it is not MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, or RTCA DO-160 standard text and cannot determine which tests a specific UAV, drone, or eVTOL product must perform [23]. |
### Minimum evidence package
| Evidence item | What it must contain | Supported basis |
|---|---|---|
| R&S configuration evidence | Exact SG/SA model, options, order numbers where available, specification document version, and required configuration notes. | SMW200A configuration and specification documents are identified by document names, document codes, versions, and dates [2]. FSW specifications are identified by document code, version, and date [67]. |
| Competitor configuration evidence | Official competitor datasheet or release note with model/SKU, option codes, version, date, availability, and test conditions. | Keysight competitor descriptions need official or third-party validation because the battle card lacks official datasheets, versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, and test conditions [10]. Anritsu product claims need verification with official datasheets, release notes, or support terms [15]. |
| Application evidence | A document that states the Aerospace / Defense measurement task and names both our configuration and the competitor configuration for that task. | The provided passages only support R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A for satellite payload complete payload testing, not a competitor comparison [34][53]. |
| Measurement evidence | Same test setup, frequency range, bandwidth, calibration state, uncertainty, environmental conditions, and pass/fail criteria for both solutions. | SMW200A and FSW specifications have stated warm-up, environmental, calibration, and adjustment conditions [61][66]. DO-160 and UAV EMC pages warn that formal limits, setups, categories, and pass/fail criteria are not provided [21][23]. |
| Claim-quality evidence | Proof that each claimed advantage is a warranted specification or validated result, not sales language. | SMW200A distinguishes warranted specifications from non-guaranteed `n. trc.`, `typ.`, `nom.`, and `meas.` data [61]. Battle-card superiority language requires formal evidence before use in technical comparisons or customer documents [25][30]. |
### What cannot be claimed from the provided passages
The provided passages do not support a direct competitor comparison for our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution in Aerospace / Defense because they do not name a competitor configuration tied to the same SG/SA Aerospace / Defense use case [97][99].
The provided passages do not support claiming that a competitor is weaker, more fragmented, lower performance, higher TCO, or less suitable for Aerospace / Defense without official competitor evidence or third-party validation [10][15][25][30].
The provided passages do not support claiming customer adoption or commercial relationship from equipment recommendations or solution mappings [42][57].

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

- 來源：[[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]。

- 文件代碼：`PD 3606.8037.92`。
- 文件版次：`Version 06.00`。
- 文件日期：`May 2024`。
- 文件性質：configuration guide；適合查 mandatory configuration、requires / not compatible / retrofitting notes、ordering information、recommended extras 與 service notes。

- 來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]。
- 文件名稱：`R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications`。
- 文件代碼：`PD 3606.8037.22`。
- 文件版次：`Version 31.00`。
- 文件日期：`May 2026`。
- 文件性質：產品 specifications；記錄 RF/baseband performance、interfaces、environmental data、ordering information 與 options。

R&S SMW200A › 基本訂購限制
依 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]] 與 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Base unit：`R&S®SMW200A`，Order No. `1412.0000.02`。
- 原文說明：Vector signal generator；includes power cable and quick start guide。
- Base unit can only be ordered with an `R&S®SMW-B10xx` frequency option and an `R&S®SMW-B13`、`R&S®SMW-B13T` or `R&S®SMW-B13XT` signal routing and baseband main module。
- 最低配置必須包含 RF path A 的一個 frequency option，以及一個 signal routing and baseband main module。
- Step 1 RF path A frequency options 不能 retrofitted。
- Step 2 baseband main module options 可 factory retrofitted；`R&S®SMW-B13XT` retrofitting only for serial number `102700` or higher。

R&S FSW
R&S FSW 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 high-end Signal and Spectrum Analyzer 系列，依 Version 17.01（September 2025）涵蓋 8 GHz 至 85 GHz 型號，[[R&S FSW85]] 搭配 R&S FSW-B90G 可延伸至 90 GHz。

[[CMW100-K06_specs_en_5214-8348-22_v0500]] 對規格類型定義如下：

- Specifications with limits 代表 warranted product performance，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits 標示為 n. trc.，因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，產品性能不保證。
- Specifications without limits 代表指定參數的 warranted product performance，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- Typical data 標示為 typ.，若標示為 `<`、`>` 或 range，代表生產時約 80% instruments 可達到的 performance；否則代表 mean value。
- Nominal values 標示為 nom.，不進行 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試該參數。
- Measured values 標示為 meas.，以個別 samples 的 measurement results 描述 expected product performance。
- Uncertainties 以 coverage factor 2 定義，依 GUM 規則計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 保證。

- 來源未提供 [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]] 的完整 datasheet、order number、完整 environmental specification 或 ESA norms 條文。
- 來源未說明 TVAC chamber 的 pressure、temperature profile、dwell time、calibration interval 或 uncertainty budget。
- 本頁只記錄 2022 application brochure 的 solution-level 說法，不可視為產品 qualification certificate。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 測試問題
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- Satellite payload qualification 需要使用 [[TVAC]] 進行 performance testing。
- Commercial off-the-shelf test and measurement equipment 無法在 TVAC conditions 下工作。
- Spectrum analyzers、vector network analyzers、signal generators 等設備必須留在 TVAC 外部，並以長 cables 連接 chamber 內的 DUT。
- Test setup 中的 cables、adapters 與 switches 會隨 TVAC temperature changes 發生 drift。
- 在不同 temperature 下於 chamber 中完成的 calibration 不再有效。
- 移動 cables 與改變 temperatures 後，需要 regular recalibration 以確保 measurement accuracy。
- TVAC 內 calibration procedure 特別困難，因 vacuum applied 時 operator 無法進入 chamber。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：提供 satellite payload and components test and measurement solutions。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：文件頁尾 copyright owner，© 2017–2022，地址標示 81671 Munich, Germany。
- [[R&S FSW]]：用於 group delay、linearity、NPR、signal quality、spurious、carrier-in-carrier 與 oscillator / synthesizer measurements；來源列 key features 為 up to 90 GHz、up to 500 GHz with external harmonic mixers、up to 8.3 GHz internal analysis bandwidth、800 MHz real-time analysis bandwidth。
- [[R&S SMW200A]]：用於 multi-carrier / modulated signal generation、OFDM waveform generation、DPD、NPR stimulus；來源列 key features 為 up to 67 GHz、up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth、with [[R&S SMW-K555]] 可達 4 GHz signal bandwidth、optional second RF path up to 44 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：用於 payload components RF measurements、converter / mixer group delay、noise figure、amplifier/filter/antenna measurements；來源列 key features 包含 up to 67 GHz、up to eight independent receivers、four phase coherent sources、two internal LO sources、internal combiner。
- [[R&S FS-SNS]]：smart noise source，用於簡化 spectrum analyzer 的 noise figure and gain measurements。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]：TVAC-compatible automatic calibration unit，可放在 chamber 內做 inline recalibration。
- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 與 [[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：TVAC-designed three-path diode power sensors，分別支援 up to 33 GHz / 67 GHz。
- [[R&S RTP]]、[[R&S RTO6]]：oscilloscopes，用於 satellite digital interface trigger、decode 與 debug。
- [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]：本來源的總題目。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：比較 spectrum analyzer + signal generator 與 VNA two-tone technique 的測試主題。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下 satellite payload qualification 測試主題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]]、[[Group delay]]、[[NPR]]、[[EVM]]、[[OFDM]]、[[Spurious emissions]]、[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 與既有知識的關係

Starlink User Terminal › Recommended RF test equipment
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 推薦：

- Spectrum analyzer：[[R&S FSW]]（43.5 GHz、POI 0.46 µs）、Keysight N9040B UXA。
- Signal generator：[[R&S SMW200A]]（100 kHz–31.8 GHz）、Keysight E8257D PSG。
- Power meter：[[R&S NRX]] with NRP33S（±2.5 dB abs）、Bird 43 wattmeter。
- VNA：Keysight PNA-X（67 GHz）、[[R&S ZNA]] for array calibration。
- Satellite simulator：Terma Ku/Ka-band for loopback EIRP / G/T testing。

這些是該 deck 的推薦清單；正式頻率範圍、POI、功率不確定度、option 需求與 order number 必須回查各產品 datasheet。

Starlink User Terminal › DVT / PVT test flow
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 列出 key steps：

- Functional test：power on、stow、normal / obstructed state check。
- RF emissions：anechoic chamber、FCC Part 15 / 25 limits、spurious <-43 dBc。
- EIRP / G/T：spectrum analyzer + power meter measurement、validate against target。
- Modulation BER：connect to gateway simulator、QPSK / 64QAM threshold test。
- Environmental：thermal cycle、drop / vibration、IP67 salt spray、snowmelt power。

更完整測試流程另見 [[Starlink User Terminal 測試流程]]。

Starlink User Terminal › Phased array evolution
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 以 beamformer impact 比較三個版本：

| 版本 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| V1 Circular | 79 DBFs、1,264 elements、motors、NF 3–4 dB |
| Rev3 Gen2 | 16 Shiraz、1,536 elements、NF 2.5–3 dB |
| Rev4 Gen3 | 6 Shiraz daisy-chain、1,536 elements、NF 2–2.5 dB、110° FOV |

來源另稱 Rev4 gains：

- Jitter 9 ms vs 112 ms Rev3。
- Down 307 Mbps。
- Power efficiency +50%。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

SDR-assisted UAV security › GPS spoofing / jamming detection
來源指出 affordable SDR devices，如 [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF 2.0]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，可用於 GNSS spoofing / jamming attacks，也可用於測試 defense mechanisms：

- [62] 提出 lightweight LSTM-based detection model，並以 knowledge distillation 壓縮，利於整合進 UAV control systems。
- [63] 研究 [[HackRF One]] 1.0 與 external TCXO 對 GNSS signal spoofing / jamming threats 的影響；受測 UAV GNSS receivers 包含 3DR IRIS+、Tarot 650 v2.2、DJI Inspire、Sky Hunter。
- [64] [[MAVIDS]] 使用 PCA 與 one-class classifiers，並以 [[HackRF One]]、[[GPS-SDR-SIM]] 與 [[GNU Radio Companion]] 進行 GPS spoofing / jamming experiments；macro-averaged F1 scores 為 GPS spoofing 90.57%、jamming 94.3%。
- [66] 使用 cellular BS 與 Wi-Fi AP crowd-sourced information 進行 GPS spoofing detection / mitigation，並以 [[HackRF One]] + TCXO 產生 spoofing signals。

SDR-assisted UAV security › unresolved
- 各 jamming / spoofing research 的法規授權、測試場地許可與 safety controls 未在本次摘要中完整展開。
- 來源沒有把 SDR-assisted security solutions 對應到商用產品 maturity level。
- [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF x40]]、[[Ettus USRP X310]] 等 device 在不同研究中的配置、firmware、clocking、antenna 與 calibration 條件需逐篇回查。

R&S ELEKTRA
[[R&S ELEKTRA]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 EMC / RSE test automation software；[[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]] 只把它列為 [[R&S TS8996]] RSE & customization 的 solution mapping，[[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）則描述它在 [[Radiated Spurious Emissions]]、[[5G FR2 RSE 測試]]、wireless EMC / EMS 與報告管理中的具體功能。

R&S ELEKTRA › Substitution method
依來源：

- RSE measurement including substitution 的 reference method 為 substitution。
- DUT replaced by a calibrated antenna with signal generator。
- Signal generator level tuned to same receive value as DUT。
- EIRP calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss。
- Supported by ELEKTRA。

R&S ELEKTRA › 來源中的角色
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- 在 [[EN 303 981]] Test Cases, Test Setup and Solutions 投影片中，[[R&S ELEKTRA]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]] RSE & customization 同列。
- 在 FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service 投影片中，[[R&S ELEKTRA]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]] RSE & customization 同列。
- 上下文包含 radiated measurement、off/on-axis spurious radiation、blocking performance、adjacent signal selectivity、Mobile Earth Station RF output power、occupied bandwidth、emission mask、out-of-band emissions 與 frequency stability。

依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- TS8996 RSE test solution 可由 [[R&S ELEKTRA]] full automation。
- 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 signal conditioning 使用 ELEKTRA 搭配 R&S spectrum analyzer / EMC test receiver 做 dedicated levelling procedure。
- Signaling section 說 ELEKTRA integrated support of CMW and CMX for 2G / 3G / 4G / 5G / WLAN / BT。
- 來源稱 ELEKTRA 可 simplified setting by selecting only RSE relevant parameters。
- ELEKTRA 可 automatic cut-out of limit line depending on carrier frequency and bandwidth。
- ELEKTRA supports SA and NSA modes for 5G，including LTE and 5G FR1 carrier in parallel。

R&S SMW200A › 規格適用條件與語彙
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）：

- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 下 storage `3 hours` 後 warm-up operation `30 minutes`、符合 specified environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval、完成所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- Specifications with limits 與 specifications without limits 代表 warranted product performance。
- `n. trc.`、`typ.`、`nom.`、`meas.` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- Uncertainties 的 coverage factor 為 `2`，依 GUM 計算。
- 依 3GPP standard，本文件中的 `Gbps`、`Mcps`、`Mbps`、`Msps`、`kbps`、`ksps`、`Msample/s` 不是 SI units。

R&S SMW200A › 主要 RF performance（Version 31.00，May 2026）
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Frequency range：依 RF path frequency option，RF path A 最高 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`；RF path B 最高 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- Overrange：`67 GHz to 72 GHz`。
- Resolution of setting：`0.001 Hz`。
- Resolution of synthesis：`0.053 nHz nominal`，條件 `f = 1 GHz`。
- Frequency setting time：依 frequency option 為 `< 1.2 ms` 至 `< 1.8 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` 為 `< 4.0 ms`。條件包含 GUI update stopped、I/Q optimization mode fast、after IEC/IEEE bus delimiter、HUMS off。
- Frequency setting time in list mode：依 frequency option為 `< 0.8 ms` 至 `< 1.4 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721`、run mode live 為 `< 4.0 ms`。
- Level setting range：`100 kHz ≤ f < 1 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +8 dBm`；`1 MHz ≤ f < 3 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +13 dBm`；`3 MHz ≤ f ≤ 67 GHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +30 dBm`。
- Standard performance SSB phase noise 條件：CW，carrier offset `20 kHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 Hz`，level `10 dBm` 或 maximum specified output power 兩者較低者；`f = 1 GHz` 為 `< –134 dBc`，typ. `–140 dBc`。
- `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` ultra low phase noise 在 `1 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–144 dBc`，typ. `–150 dBc`；在 `67 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–105 dBc`，typ. `–111 dBc`。
- Pulse modulation 需 `R&S®SMW-K22`；一般 on/off ratio `> 80 dB`，部分高頻條件例外為 `> 65 dB`。
- Pulse rise/fall time（10 % / 90 % of RF amplitude）：低頻 frequency options fast transition `< 10 ns`；多數 20 GHz 以上 options fast transition `< 15 ns`；smoothed transition 多數條件 `< 200 ns`。
- Internal baseband I/Q、wideband baseband (`R&S®SMW-B13XT`)、I/Q wideband on：`f > 2.5 GHz` 時 `±1 GHz`；RF modulation bandwidth 可達 `2 GHz`。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

R&S FSW › 共通規格條件
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時、warm-up operation 30 分鐘、符合指定 environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且若適用已完成 internal automatic adjustments。
- Frequency resolution：0.01 Hz。
- Recommended calibration interval：1 year。
- Operating temperature range：+5 °C to +50 °C。
- Permissible temperature range：0 °C to +55 °C。
- Storage temperature range：–40 °C to +70 °C。
- Display：30.7 cm WXGA color touchscreen，1280 × 800 pixel。
- Internal data storage：standard solid state disk ≥ 128 Gbyte。
- AC input voltage range：100 V to 240 V；AC supply frequency：50 Hz to 60 Hz / 400 Hz。

### Short answer
To compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense, the evidence must directly connect the same Aerospace / Defense use case, our exact signal generator / signal analyzer configuration, the competitor’s exact configuration, and the same test conditions; the provided passages only separately mention “Aerospace & Defense Test” and “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer,” not a supported competitor comparison [97][99].
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Supported basis |
|---|---|---|
| Our exact product models, option codes, document version, and dated specifications must be cited from official product documents. | R&S SMW200A claims should be tied to its configuration guide and specifications, and R&S FSW claims should be tied to its specifications document version and date. | SMW200A evidence is based on `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator – Configuration guide` Version 06.00 May 2024 and `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` Version 31.00 May 2026 [2]. FSW evidence is based on `FSW_specs_en_5215-6749-22_v1701`, Version 17.01, September 2025 [67]. |
| The competitor’s official datasheet, model/SKU, option codes, version, release status, and test conditions must be collected before making claims. | Existing competitor material is not enough where it lacks official datasheets, versions, order numbers, option codes, or test conditions. | The Keysight battle card lacks official UXM datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, and test conditions [10]. The Anritsu page says product frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option code, software tools, and support model need verification with Anritsu official datasheets, release notes, or support terms [15]. |
| The Aerospace / Defense application must be tied to the actual SG/SA use case, not just co-mentioned. | The available raw evidence separately names Aerospace & Defense Test and Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer, but it does not state a competitor comparison. | The raw passages show “Aerospace & Defense Test” in a presentation title context [97]. The raw passages separately list “Signal Generator” and “Signal Analyzer” [99]. |
| If the use case is satellite payload testing, use the application evidence that explicitly links R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A to complete payload testing. | This is a supported SG/SA application link, but it is not a competitor comparison by itself. | R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are recommended for complete payload testing [34]. The same source says they cover group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality for satellite payload and component testing [53]. |
| Comparable specifications must include the exact measurement conditions and whether the data is warranted, typical, nominal, or measured. | Non-warranted or conditionless numbers should not be used as binding comparison claims. | SMW200A product data applies after 3 hours storage at ambient temperature, 30 minutes warm-up, specified environmental conditions, recommended calibration interval, and applicable internal adjustments [61]. SMW200A specifications with and without limits are warranted, while `n. trc.`, `typ.`, `nom.`, and `meas.` are not guaranteed [61]. FSW product data has its own 3-hour storage, 30-minute warm-up, environmental, calibration, and adjustment conditions [66]. |
| Frequency range, bandwidth, and option requirements must be compared only where both sides have official evidence. | Our side has supported SG/SA specifications, but competitor-side equivalent evidence is not provided in the passages. | SMW200A RF path A can cover up to `100 kHz to 67 GHz`, RF path B can cover up to `100 kHz to 44 GHz`, and wideband baseband RF modulation bandwidth can reach `2 GHz` under stated conditions [63]. FSW models cover up to 85 GHz, and FSW85 with R&S FSW-B90G can extend to 90 GHz [68]. FSW analysis bandwidth options range up to 8.312 GHz with option-specific applicability and restrictions [6]. |
| Claims such as “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or competitor weaknesses require formal external evidence. | Existing battle-card wording is sales positioning and cannot be treated as verified technical fact. | The Keysight battle card contains sales language such as only, first, leadership, lower TCO, and fewer boxes, and says formal evidence is needed before using those claims in technical comparisons or customer documents [25]. The R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu page says “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “widest frequency range,” and “lower TCO” are sales language and should not be treated as verifiable technical specifications [30]. |
| Customer adoption, market share, procurement, or partnership claims require separate dated evidence. | A market mapping or equipment recommendation does not prove adoption, customer fit, or commercial relationship. | The Taiwan satellite mapping page says R&S Solution mappings do not indicate supply, purchase, mass production, certification, contract, shipment, revenue contribution, or commercial relationship with Rohde & Schwarz [57]. The Starlink User Terminal flow says equipment recommendations must not be used to infer R&S, Keysight, or Terma adoption or commercial relationships [42]. |
| Standards-based Aerospace / Defense claims require the actual standard version, test category, limits, setup, and pass/fail criteria. | The available DO-160 and military drone EMC materials are only solution or presentation-level summaries, not formal standards. | The DO-160 page says it is not a formal RTCA DO-160 standard summary and must not be used to infer complete categories, limits, waveforms, test setup, or pass/fail criteria [21]. The military UAV EMC page says it is not MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, or RTCA DO-160 standard text and cannot determine which tests a specific UAV, drone, or eVTOL product must perform [23]. |
### Minimum evidence package
| Evidence item | What it must contain | Supported basis |
|---|---|---|
| R&S configuration evidence | Exact SG/SA model, options, order numbers where available, specification document version, and required configuration notes. | SMW200A configuration and specification documents are identified by document names, document codes, versions, and dates [2]. FSW specifications are identified by document code, version, and date [67]. |
